briefs.text: Landmine casualties hit a five-year high of about 7,000, Myanmar and Syria worst affected.
President Trump awards Rudy Giuliani the Medal of Freedom, America's highest civilian honour.
Washington is set to unveil new tariffs after a probe into excess factory capacity, reports say.
India's Vaibhav Suryavanshi, 15, smashes a world-record 204 off 53 balls at the Rising Stars Asia Cup.

cards.body: Tehran's Revolutionary Guard said two tankers exploded and caught fire after striking naval mines in the strait early on Wednesday. The claim is unverified; attacks on shipping near Hormuz are at their highest since February.
cards.headline: Iran says two tankers hit mines in Hormuz

cards.body: China's Shenzhou-24 mission carried a Pakistani astronaut to the Tiangong space station — the first foreign national to fly aboard a Chinese crewed spacecraft.
cards.headline: Shenzhou-24 lifts off with first Pakistani astronaut

cards.body: Beijing's anti-corruption watchdog is investigating Politburo member and Shanghai party secretary Chen Jining — the most senior official felled in the biggest party shake-up in decades.
cards.headline: Shanghai party chief Chen Jining under graft probe

cards.body: A US federal jury convicted China's Huawei in a sprawling criminal trial over trade-secret theft and its dealings with Iran, capping years of legal battles.
cards.headline: US jury convicts Huawei of stealing trade secrets

cards.body: Armed men took 25 people hostage inside a Colombian supermarket after a failed raid on an armoured cash truck, as police surrounded the building.
cards.headline: Gunmen seize 25 hostages in supermarket siege

cards.body: A suspected gas explosion tore through a building in Vietnam's capital, Hanoi, killing six people and injuring ten, Vietnamese authorities said on Wednesday.
cards.headline: Suspected gas explosion in Hanoi kills six

footer: Compiled from agency reports — AFP · AP · dpa · Xinhua · The National · SCMP · Japan Times

lead.body: A drone struck the 80-storey PIF Tower in Riyadh's financial district, its second hit in under a week. Saudi Civil Defence said 11 people were hurt. The Saudi-led coalition answered with strikes on Yemen's Hodeidah port, and the Houthis threatened Red Sea ports.
lead.headline: Houthi drone hits Riyadh's tallest tower again — 11 injured

tagline: One day of world news, in one picture
